description: Defines a template class FixedString for stack-allocated, fixed-size string buffers supporting appending, comparison, and conversion to std::string_view, optimized for no-malloc operations. Includes specific FixedString typedefs for sizes 30 and 62.

classes.name: FixedString
classes.description: A template class implementing a fixed-size, stack-allocated string buffer supporting appending various types, comparison, and conversion to std::string_view.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Syntactic sugar for appending multiple arguments to a FixedString instance.
